guidance.additional_user_statement: An ENTERABLE setup can be entered or re-entered using the latest published stop.
guidance.quote: Setups are moved to 'underway' when they've gone what we consider too far for entry. Those setups (ZETA, CCL) may have triggered entries for some traders but the setup remains attractive to monitor for a fresh entry.
